name: Kawaii Adobenshaas in Anime Rando
source: In Kawaii Adobenshaas in Anime Rand, Steve is an ordinary schoolboy who is one day magically transformed into a sparkling anime named Chichi-chan in animes land. In animes land, he meets Kiwi-chan, a genki catgirl who hates shaving her legs, Mumi-chan, his slutty toddler imouto who begs for his cock, Gupi-chan, Chichi-chan's new robot meido love slave who is trying discretely to fit in with human society, Nuki-chan, a shy bookworm, and Geroshabou-chan, an anime version of Helga from Hey Arnold.
translation: 在《Kawaii Adobenshaas in Anime Rando》裡，史蒂夫是一名普通的學生，有一天他神奇地變成了動漫王國中一位名叫Chichi-chan的閃閃發亮的動畫角色。在動漫世界中，他遇到了討厭剃腿毛的元氣貓耳娘Kiwi-chan、央求他給她雞巴的淫蕩幼妹Mumi-chan、Chichi-chan新來的機器人女僕兼愛奴Gupi-chan，她正努力悄悄融入人類社會、害羞的書呆子Nuki-chan以及Geroshabou-chan，也就是《Hey Arnold!》中Helga的日式動畫版。
